All packages below are derived entirely from explicit bechina language and clear thematic equivalences in the LM2/88 source text (torah_88.txt). The Rebbe himself describes this Torah as sealed ('דברים סתומים וחתומים') and the scribe notes that some content was forgotten and only written in hints. packages.label: אֲבֵדוֹת וּמַלְאָךְ הַשּׁוֹפָר
packages.label_en: Lost Things and the Shofar Angel
packages.reason: The angel and his deputies holding shofars are explicitly called a bechina of 'תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד' (para 9) — meaning they are the celestial force that recovers what the wicked's desires cause to be lost. The אֲבֵדוֹת (lost things) are what the angel seeks. The shofar blasts TRT (Tekiah-Teruah-Tekiah) are how he signals the finding. These all share the same essential nature: they are expressions of the divine recovery system — the positive force that seeks, finds, and restores what has been spiritually lost. The great noise and joy upon finding an אֲבֵדָה (para 6) is the same domain. The righteous person (tzaddik) with strong avodah can also extract additional חִיּוּת from the fruit and 'find lost things there' (para 3) — meaning the tzaddik is a bechina of this same angel-function on earth.
key_bechina_proofs: המלאכים המחפשים אחר האבדות, שהם בחינת תאוות רשעים תאבד — הם אוחזים בידם שופרות ותוקעים תר"ת (para 9)
אפילו הצדיקים החופרים ומבקשים אחר אבדות — הם אובדים גם כן לפעמים, בבחינת: יחפרו ויאבדו (para 8)
וכשהם מוצאים איזה אבדה, נעשה רעש ושמחה גדולה (para 6)
תאוות רשעים תאבד — ראשי תיבות: תקיעה, תרועה, תקיעה (para 9)

merge_notes.reason: The text presents the מַלְאָךְ and the מְמֻנִּים under him as a single unified seeking-force: 'יש מלאך, ותחתיו כמה ממונים, וכולם אוחזים בידם שופרות' (para 6). They share exactly the same function and domain — seeking lost things with shofars. They are the same essential nature at different hierarchical levels.

The tzaddikim who dig and seek after lost things (para 8: 'הצדיקים החופרים ומבקשים אחר אבדות') are performing the same function as the angel — they are the earthly bechina of the celestial recovery mission. Para 3 also states that the strong tzaddik 'can extract additional life-force from the fruit and find lost things there' — he IS operating in the angel's domain.

packages.label: תַּאֲוָה וְאַבְדָּן
packages.reason: The evil mirror of Package 1. Just as the angel's domain is recovery of lost things, the domain of desires (תַּאֲווֹת) is the cause of spiritual loss. Para 7: 'מה שאובדים אבדות הרבה על ידי התאוות, בבחינת: תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד'. The wicked (רְשָׁעִים) are those driven by these desires. Loss (אַבְדָּן) is the shared essential nature — what happens when taavah operates. The tzaddik who loses despite his righteousness (para 8: 'יש צדיק אובד בצדקו') reflects the paradox of 'עֵת לְאַבֵּד' — even the good side can lose, which is itself a form of the losing-domain. The premature-fruit eating (para 1-2) is the concrete physical expression of this desire that causes loss of soul-life.
key_bechina_proofs: אובדים אבדות הרבה על ידי התאוות, בבחינת: תאוות רשעים תאבד (para 7)
האוכל פרי קודם גמר בשולה יכולה להזיק לו מאד לנשמתו, כי יוכל לאבד נפשו על ידי זה (para 1) — the desire to eat unripe fruit is the prototype taavah causing loss
יש צדיק אובד בצדקו (Ecclesiastes 7:15, cited para 8) — the bechina of paradoxical loss
עת לאבד (Ecclesiastes 3, cited para 8) — the time of losing is itself a bechina category

merge_notes.reason: The verse 'תַּאֲוַת רְשָׁעִים תֹּאבֵד' is not just a proof text — it IS the essential description of this domain. The Rebbe treats it as both the category-name and the mechanism: desires of the wicked cause loss. It IS the same node as תַּאֲוָה in its fully expressed form.

Eating unripe fruit before its time is the concrete embodiment of taavah in this Torah — the impulsive desire that does not wait for natural completion. The fruit-eating is not a separate domain; it is the physical instantiation of taavah as the cause of soul-loss. The entire first half of the Torah is the taavah that destroys in physical form.

packages.label: בְּרָכָה וְיִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
packages.reason: Para 3 explicitly presents בְּרָכָה (the blessing over fruit) with כַּוָּנָה (intention) and יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם (fear of heaven) as the protective force that saves a person from the fruit's drawing power. These three are not cause-and-effect in sequence — they are three names for the same essential spiritual stance of mindful divine awareness. The same verse ('כַּוָּנָה וּבְיִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם') makes them coterminous. The חוֹזֵק בְּיוֹתֵר בַּעֲבוֹדַת ה' (one who is especially strong in divine service, para 3) is the fullest expression of this same domain — so strong that he can even draw out additional life-force and find lost things. This package is the middle ground between the loss-domain (Pkg 2) and the recovery-domain (Pkg 1).
key_bechina_proofs: אם מברך הברכה של הפרי בכוונה וביראת שמים, אזי יוכל להנצל מזה (para 3)
גם אם הוא חזק ביותר בעבודת ה', יוכל גם כן להוציא עוד חיות מהפרי, ולמצא שם אבדות (para 3) — the fully realized brachah/yirah-domain enables even finding lost things

כוונת אלול, שהם תיקון לפגם הברית (para 11) — the Rebbe connects this domain to the kavanot of Elul which rectify the covenant-blemish, showing that the blessing/awareness domain is the same as the Elul-teshuvah domain

merge_notes.reason: The text joins them in one phrase: 'בכוונה וביראת שמים' (para 3). They are presented as a single combined state of consciousness, not as sequential steps. In Breslov teaching, intention and fear of heaven are two names for the same mindful awareness before God.

The one who is 'חזק ביותר בעבודת ה'' (para 3) is the fullest realization of יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם — they are not different domains but different degrees of the same essential spiritual orientation. Being strong in avodah IS the full flowering of fear of heaven.

packages.label: פְּרִי וְכֹחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁךְ
packages.reason: The fruit (פְּרִי) and its drawing force (כֹּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁךְ) are structural/natural concepts that are the vehicle of this Torah's teaching. The fruit is not itself good or evil — it has a natural force when unripe that can harm, and a completed state that is permitted. The כֹּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁךְ is a natural property, like a physical organ, used as a spiritual metaphor. The ripening process (בִּשּׁוּל), the plucking (תְּלִישָׁה), and the waiting period (הַמְתָּנָה until the fruit ripens on its own in a detached state, para 5) are all facets of this neutral structural cluster. The human analogy given in para 5 — 'like a tired person who puffs many times (sappen/gasps) until he rests' — is itself a bechina of this fruit-rest process, showing the neutrality of the metaphor.
key_bechina_proofs: הפרי כל זמן שהיא צריכה להתגדל, יש לה כח המושך, כי היא צריכה חיות להתגדל (para 2)
כשמתבשלת כל צרכה, שוב פסק ממנה כח המושך, כי אינה צריכה עוד למשוך חיות (para 2)
תוכל הפרי למשוך לעצמה חיות הנפש של זה האדם (para 2) — the fruit's drawing force IS the life-force mechanism, they share the same nature
זה דומה כמו האדם שהוא יגע, והוא מרחף רחיפות הרבה בפיו... עד אשר ינוח (para 5) — the fruit's rest-period IS a bechina of human panting/resting

merge_notes.reason: The drawing force (כֹּחַ הַמּוֹשֵׁךְ) and the life-force (חִיּוּת) are co-defined: 'יש לה כח המושך, כי היא צריכה חיות להתגדל' (para 2). The drawing force IS the life-force-seeking mechanism. They are two aspects of the same natural property.

The waiting period until the detached fruit ripens on its own (para 5) is a form of בִּשּׁוּל — natural ripening after plucking. The text says 'מותר לאכלן' after this wait, showing it achieves the same goal as full on-tree ripening. They are two modes of the same completion-process.

stats.notes: This Torah is explicitly described as sealed and partially forgotten. The four packages map to the Torah's core structural poles: (1) the celestial recovery system / angel-shofar domain [good], (2) the taavah-loss domain [evil], (3) the brachah-yirah-avodah protective domain [good], (4) the neutral fruit/life-force structural metaphor [neutral]. The Torah's argument is: taavah causes loss → fruit's drawing force is the mechanism → brachah/yirah protects → the celestial angel with shofars recovers what is lost. All of this is stated to be one integrated unit (para 11: 'הכל אחד').
